UT_ADC_OUTCOME

Table to store the outcome of ADC operations during tests.

Columns
test_name

Name of the test executed

sort_seq

Sort criteria derived from the test number and execution step

cru_id

Reference to ADC_RULE, ID of the rule executed

cru_sort_seq

Sort criteria of the rule executed

cru_name

Name of the rule executed

cru_firing_items

List of page items ADC sees as firing

cru_fire_on_page_load

Flag to indicate whether this rule fires in addition to other page initialization rules

item

Name of the page item an action refers to

pl_sql

PL/SQL pattern that is executed as part of the action

js

JavaScript pattern that is executed as part of the action

cra_sort_seq

Sort criteria of the action executed

cra_param_1

Optional first parameter for the action

cra_param_2

Optional second parameter for the action

cra_param_3

Optional third parameter for the action

cra_on_error

Flag to indicate whether the executed action is an exception handler

cru_on_error

Flag to indicate whether the executed rule has an error

is_first_row

Flag to indicate the first output row of a test

id

Name of the test executed

crg_id

Rule group ID

firing_item

Page item that actually caused the ADC activity

firing_event

Event that actually caused the ADC activity

error_dependent_items

List of page items to disable if at least one error was registered

bind_items

List of page items to bind event handlers to

firing_items

List of items that got changed during rule execution

error_stack

JSON instance of all exceptions that occurred during rule execution

recursive_stack

List of recursively called rules

js_action_stack

Script with all JavaScript actions to be executed in response to ADC activity

is_recursive

Flag to indicate whether a rule is recursive

level_length

Name of the test executed

allow_recursion

Flag that allows or disallows recursive execution of an action or rule

notification_stack

Additional comments on the execution of a rule

stop_flag

Flag that indicates that a rule execution was stopped due to an error
